title: Thomas Romain
author: Thomas Romain
description:
I'm a French animation creator, designer, and illustrator based in Japan. People know me for being the co-creator of shows such as Code Lyoko or Oban Star-racers, and also for drawing fantasy artworks based on my sons' drawings. My next challenge is to develop games and other various projects.

If you want to support me you can purchase our "Family Traits" artbook, available on amazon and such.
